generic.Defined scope/population: Audited claim files requiring coverage analysis, liability determination and reserve-adequacy scoring
generic.In-scope period: Claims placed in the audit queue for the current monthly quality review period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Coverage position date, fault percentage and indemnity plus expense reserve are all present
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reserve worksheet total agrees to paid-to-date plus outstanding in ClaimCenter financials
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Coverage memo and reserve worksheet versions stored on the claim file with dates
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every coverage or reserve-adequacy deficiency logged on the scorecard with a disposition
generic.Test population: All claims scored for coverage and reserve quality in the review period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where no dated coverage position exists or reserve movement over 25% carries no note
generic.Exception handling path: Deficiencies routed to the adjuster debrief with a dated corrective action
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Published rubric definitions for coverage, liability and reserve adequacy scoring bands
generic.Evidence location: Audit record in Guidewire ClaimCenter and the scoring workbook in Microsoft Excel

steps.title: Open the audited claim Coverage tab in Guidewire ClaimCenter
sop: Open the claim by claim number and select the Coverage tab.
Confirm a written coverage position letter or memo is attached and dated within standards.
Done when the coverage position document and its date are identified.
verify: Check the attachment date sits inside the coverage-position standard.
Pass when a dated coverage position document is on the audited claim.

steps.title: Reconcile the coverage analysis to the policy record in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the declarations page and endorsement list for the policy in force at date of loss.
Compare limits, deductible and endorsements cited in the coverage analysis against the policy.
Done when every cited term is matched or a mismatch is noted.
verify: Re-read the coverage memo against the declarations for limit and deductible agreement.
Pass when no coverage term cited in the analysis conflicts with the policy record.

steps.title: Score the liability determination in the audit workbook in Microsoft Excel
sop: Read the liability section of the file including statements, photographs and reports.
Confirm a comparative or contributory fault percentage is stated with supporting facts.
Score the element and write a one-line rationale in the workbook.
Done when the liability score and rationale are entered.
verify: Check the score carries a rationale referencing specific file evidence.
Pass when no bare-conclusion liability determination is scored as compliant.

steps.title: Test reserve adequacy against the reserve worksheet in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the reserve worksheet and the current financials on the claim.
Compare indemnity plus expense reserve against paid-to-date and the current damages evaluation.
Record the adequacy conclusion with the figures relied on.
Done when the reserve adequacy conclusion is recorded.
verify: Recompute outstanding reserve from the financials screen and compare to the worksheet.
Pass when the reserve conclusion cites paid-to-date and the damages evaluation.

steps.title: Flag unexplained reserve movement over 25% in the Excel scoring workbook
sop: List every reserve change on the claim from the initial reserve onward.
Identify any movement over 25% of the initial reserve with no corresponding file note.
Flag each as a reserve-adequacy deficiency with the transaction date.
Done when all unexplained movements are flagged.
verify: Cross-check each flagged movement against the file note history in ClaimCenter.
Pass when every reserve change either carries a rationale note or is flagged.

steps.title: Record the coverage and reserve scores on the audit record in ClaimCenter
sop: Enter the coverage, liability and reserve element scores on the audit record.
Attach or deep-link the evidence supporting each deficiency.
Done when the scored elements and evidence links are saved.
verify: Reopen the audit record and confirm no scored element is blank.
Pass when every deficiency on the record carries an evidence link.

generic.Defined scope/population: Audit scores disputed by the handling adjuster and queued for calibration panel review
generic.In-scope period: Disputes raised in the current audit cycle and open past 10 business days
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Original score, rebuttal text, second blind score and agreed final score are all captured
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Disputed-queue count matches the number of audits calibrated in the session minutes
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Calibration minutes stored with session date and the rubric version used
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every rubric line that split the panel logged with a clarification action
generic.Test population: All audits in Disputed status at the start of the calibration session
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Escalate any element where the two blind scores differ by more than one band
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved splits routed to a rubric-clarification action with a named owner
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Published scoring rubric bands and the calibration protocol for blind second scoring
generic.Evidence location: Audit records in Guidewire ClaimCenter and calibration minutes in Microsoft Excel

steps.title: Pull the disputed-score queue from the BI/reporting platform
sop: Run the disputed-audit report for the current cycle.
List every audit where the adjuster rebuttal has been open past 10 business days.
Done when the aged dispute list is produced.
verify: Compare the list count against open Disputed audits in ClaimCenter.
Pass when every dispute open past 10 business days appears on the list.

steps.title: Assign a second blind reviewer to each disputed file in ClaimCenter
sop: Assign a second auditor who did not perform the original audit.
Withhold the original score and rationale from the second auditor.
Done when every disputed file has a named blind second reviewer.
verify: Check no file is assigned back to its original auditor.
Pass when each disputed file shows an independent second reviewer.

steps.title: Record both independent scores in the calibration workbook in Microsoft Excel
sop: Re-read the disputed claim file in ClaimCenter without seeing the first score.
Enter the second independent score per rubric element in the workbook.
Enter the original score alongside it only after both are locked.
Done when both independent scores are recorded before discussion.
verify: Confirm the workbook entries show the second score locked before disclosure.
Pass when no disputed file has only a single recorded score.

steps.title: Log the rubric line item behind each score split in Excel
sop: Compare the two scores element by element.
Where scores differ by more than one band, log the rubric line that caused the split.
Done when every split element is tied to a rubric line.
verify: Check each split has a named rubric line rather than a general comment.
Pass when no split element is logged without its rubric line.

steps.title: Agree the final score per disputed element in the calibration session
sop: Work through each split element with the panel.
Agree a single final score and capture the agreed rationale.
Record the calibrated score against the audit record in ClaimCenter.
Done when every disputed element has an agreed final score.
verify: Reopen each audit and confirm original, calibrated score and rationale are present.
Pass when no audit remains in Disputed status after the session closes.

steps.title: Raise rubric-clarification actions in the calibration minutes
sop: Identify any rubric line that split the panel twice or more.
Raise a rubric-clarification action with an owner and due date.
Circulate the minutes to all auditors with the agreed interpretations.
Done when the actions and minutes are issued.
verify: Check each repeat-split rubric line has an open clarification action.
Pass when the minutes record session date, attendees and agreed rationale.

generic.Defined scope/population: Completed audits requiring a findings debrief with the handling adjuster
generic.In-scope period: Audits completed in the current review cycle and not yet debriefed
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Debrief date, attendees, acknowledgement flag and action due dates are all captured
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Debriefed audit count matches completed audits carrying at least one deficiency
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Debrief summary saved to the claim file repository with the debrief date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each rebutted deficiency logged with the rebuttal basis and the reviewer decision
generic.Test population: All completed audits with at least one recorded deficiency
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a below-threshold audit closes with no recorded debrief entry
generic.Exception handling path: Rebutted deficiencies routed to calibration review before the audit is closed
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Debrief standard requiring line-by-line citation and dated corrective actions
generic.Evidence location: Audit debrief record in Guidewire ClaimCenter and summary in the claim file repository

steps.title: Prepare the deficiency pack from the audit record in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the completed audit and list each deficiency line on the scorecard.
Attach the specific file note, letter or reserve entry evidencing each deficiency.
Done when every deficiency has its supporting citation.
verify: Check no deficiency line is listed without a file citation.
Pass when the pack cites evidence for each scored deduction.

steps.title: Schedule the debrief with the handling adjuster in ClaimCenter
sop: Set the debrief date within the standard turnaround from audit completion.
Invite the handling adjuster and record the planned attendee list.
Done when the debrief is scheduled and attendees recorded.
verify: Confirm the scheduled date falls inside the debrief standard.
Pass when every completed audit with deficiencies has a scheduled debrief.

steps.title: Walk the adjuster through each deficiency line on the scorecard
sop: Take each deficiency in turn and read the citation from the file.
Explain the rubric expectation and why the handling fell short.
Done when every deficiency line has been discussed.
verify: Check the debrief note covers each scored deficiency.
Pass when no deficiency is closed out without discussion.

steps.title: Capture adjuster acknowledgement or rebuttal per deficiency in ClaimCenter
sop: State acknowledgement or formal rebuttal for each deficiency raised.
Give the factual basis for any rebuttal.
Record the response against each deficiency on the audit record.
Done when every deficiency carries an acknowledgement or rebuttal.
verify: Reopen the audit and confirm no deficiency is left unanswered.
Pass when each deficiency shows an acknowledged or rebutted flag.

steps.title: Agree file-level corrective actions with due dates in ClaimCenter
sop: Agree the fix for each accepted deficiency such as issuing a missing ROR letter.
Set a due date and owner for each corrective action.
Log the actions on the audit record.
Done when every accepted deficiency has a dated corrective action.
verify: Check each action names an owner and a due date.
Pass when no accepted deficiency lacks a corrective action.

steps.title: Record the debrief and copy the supervisor via the claim file repository
sop: Record the debrief date, attendees and agreed actions on the audit record.
File the debrief summary in the claim file repository against the claim.
Copy the adjuster supervisor where the file scored below the pass threshold.
Done when the debrief record and distribution are complete.
verify: Check the audit record shows debrief date, attendees and acknowledgement.
Pass when no closed audit with a below-threshold score lacks a debrief entry.

generic.Defined scope/population: Audits performed in the cycle requiring a completed record in the quality management system
generic.In-scope period: Audits conducted between the period open date and the period close date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claim number, audit type, every rubric element score and deficiency category are populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Completed audit count matches the sampled claim list drawn for the period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each deficiency links to a dated file note, letter or financial entry
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Deficiencies tagged to category and carried into the corrective-action list
generic.Test population: All audit records created against sampled claims in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where any rubric element is blank or the record is still Draft at period close
generic.Exception handling path: Draft or incomplete audit records returned to the auditor before the scorecard extract
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Audit documentation standard defining audit types, rubric elements and deficiency categories
generic.Evidence location: Audit records in Guidewire ClaimCenter and the period scorecard extract in Microsoft Excel

steps.title: Create the audit record against the claim number in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the sampled claim and create a new audit record.
Select the correct audit type of random, targeted or post-training.
Done when the audit record exists with the right type.
verify: Compare the audit type against the sampling trigger reason.
Pass when the audit type matches the reason the claim was selected.

steps.title: Enter a score for every rubric element on the audit record
sop: Score each rubric element in turn.
Leave no element blank to force a pass result.
Done when every rubric element carries a score.
verify: Scan the record for unscored elements before saving.
Pass when no rubric element is blank on the audit record.

steps.title: Tag each deficiency to its category in ClaimCenter
sop: Assign each deficiency to coverage, investigation, reserving, documentation, timeliness or customer contact.
Use the controlled category list rather than free text.
Done when every deficiency carries a category tag.
verify: Check no deficiency is left with a blank or free-text category.
Pass when each deficiency maps to a controlled category value.

steps.title: Attach or deep-link the evidencing document to each deficiency
sop: Locate the file note, letter or financial entry proving the deficiency.
Attach it or deep-link it from the claim file repository.
Done when every deficiency has an evidence link.
verify: Open two links at random and confirm they resolve to the cited item.
Pass when every deficiency on the record resolves to an evidence item.

steps.title: Set the audit status to Complete in ClaimCenter
sop: Review the record for blank scores or untagged deficiencies.
Set the status to Complete.
Done when the audit record status reads Complete.
verify: Re-run the Draft audit report for the period.
Pass when no audit record sits in Draft status after the period close date.

steps.title: Confirm the audit appears in the period scorecard extract in Excel
sop: Run the quality scorecard extract for the current period.
Confirm the completed audit and its scores appear in the extract.
Done when the audit is present in the extract.
verify: Reconcile extract record count to completed audits in ClaimCenter.
Pass when the extract count equals the completed audit count for the period.

generic.Defined scope/population: Period audit deficiencies grouped by category to separate systemic from file-specific failures
generic.In-scope period: Deficiencies raised on audits completed in the current reporting period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Category, failure rate, population size, affected adjusters and exemplar claims are recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Deficiency counts by category reconcile to the completed audit extract for the period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issue statement and supporting extract stored on the GRC issue record with a date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each systemic issue logged in the GRC register with owner and target remediation date
generic.Test population: All audited files in the period grouped by deficiency category
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Escalate any category failing on more than 15% of audited files
generic.Exception handling path: Issues below threshold handled through individual adjuster debriefs instead of escalation
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Systemic-issue definition requiring recurrence across at least two adjusters or two teams
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform issue register with the supporting BI extract and audit records in ClaimCenter

steps.title: Group period deficiencies by category in the BI/reporting platform
sop: Run the deficiency extract for the completed audits in the period.
Group deficiencies by category and compute the failure rate over audited files.
Done when the failure rate per category is produced.
verify: Reconcile the audited file count in the extract to the audit records in ClaimCenter.
Pass when the extract file count equals the completed audit count for the period.

steps.title: Identify categories breaching the 15% threshold in the BI platform
sop: Compare each category failure rate against the 15% threshold.
List every category above the threshold.
Done when the breaching categories are listed.
verify: Recompute one breaching rate by hand from the underlying counts.
Pass when each listed category is above 15% of audited files.

steps.title: Confirm recurrence across adjusters or teams in ClaimCenter
sop: Break each breaching category down by adjuster and by team.
Confirm the pattern repeats across at least two adjusters or two teams.
Discard patterns concentrated on a single file or handler.
Done when systemic patterns are separated from file-specific ones.
verify: Check each retained pattern names at least two adjusters or teams.
Pass when no single-handler pattern is carried forward as systemic.

steps.title: Write the issue statement with population and exemplars in the BI platform
sop: State the population size, the failure rate and the affected cohort.
Name two or three exemplar claim numbers that illustrate the failure.
Done when the issue statement is drafted with figures and exemplars.
verify: Check the statement cites both audit population size and exemplar claim numbers.
Pass when no issue statement is raised without population size and exemplars.

steps.title: Escalate the issue to claims management with a recommended intervention
sop: Review the issue statement and the supporting evidence.
Agree the intervention of process change, guideline update or targeted training.
Done when the intervention is agreed and recorded.
verify: Check each escalated issue carries a named recommended intervention.
Pass when no systemic issue is escalated without a proposed intervention.

steps.title: Log the issue in the GRC platform issue register
sop: Create the issue record with category, failure rate and population size.
Assign a named owner and a target remediation date.
Attach the issue statement and the supporting extract.
Done when the GRC issue record is saved and assigned.
verify: Reopen the register entry and confirm owner, rate and target date are set.
Pass when every systemic issue is logged with owner, failure rate and target date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Sampled claim files tested for documentation completeness against the claims-handling standard
generic.In-scope period: Material file activity in the 90 days preceding the audit date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loss notice, declarations, coverage position and correspondence are indexed to the claim
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Repository document count matches the documents referenced in the claim activity log
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each indexed document retains its upload timestamp and version in the repository
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each missing document or note logged as a documentation deficiency with a disposition
generic.Test population: All claims in the audit sample scored on the documentation rubric element
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a decision was made with no supporting document or contemporaneous note
generic.Exception handling path: Documentation deficiencies routed to the adjuster debrief for corrective indexing
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claims-handling standard requiring a file note within 24 hours of each material activity
generic.Evidence location: Claim file/document repository index and the audit record in Guidewire ClaimCenter

steps.title: Confirm core documents are attached to the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the claim documents view for the sampled claim.
Confirm the loss notice, policy declarations and coverage position are all attached.
Done when the presence or absence of each core document is recorded.
verify: Check each core document opens from the claim rather than a personal folder.
Pass when loss notice, declarations and coverage position are all indexed to the claim.

steps.title: Test file notes against material activity in the last 90 days
sop: List material activities on the claim in the last 90 days from the activity log.
Confirm each has a contemporaneous file note within 24 hours of the activity.
Record any activity without a timely note.
Done when every material activity is tested.
verify: Compare note timestamps against activity timestamps for the sample.
Pass when no material activity in the review window lacks a corresponding file note.

steps.title: Confirm evidence items are indexed in the claim file repository
sop: Search the repository for recorded statements, estimates and photographs on the claim.
Confirm each is linked to the claim number and not held in a personal folder.
Done when all evidence items are confirmed indexed or flagged missing.
verify: Retrieve two evidence items by claim number from the repository.
Pass when every evidence item retrieves against the claim number.

steps.title: Verify outbound correspondence is stored against the claim
sop: List the acknowledgement, reservation of rights, status and denial letters issued.
Confirm each is stored in the document repository against the claim.
Done when every outbound letter is located or flagged missing.
verify: Check the repository index against the letters recorded in ClaimCenter.
Pass when every issued letter appears in the repository index for the claim.

steps.title: Mark undocumented decisions as deficient on the audit record
sop: Identify decisions on the file with no supporting document or note.
Mark the file deficient on the documentation rubric element.
Record the specific decision that lacks support.
Done when each undocumented decision is recorded as a deficiency.
verify: Check each documentation deficiency names the unsupported decision.
Pass when no undocumented decision is scored as compliant.

steps.title: Record the documentation completeness score in ClaimCenter
sop: Enter the documentation element score on the audit record.
Attach the evidence reference for each deficiency raised.
Done when the score and evidence references are saved.
verify: Reopen the audit record and confirm the documentation element is scored.
Pass when the documentation score carries a rationale for each deduction.

generic.Defined scope/population: Sampled claims tested against state regulatory contact, acknowledgement and decision deadlines
generic.In-scope period: Claims with FNOL, contact or decision events falling in the review period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: FNOL receipt, acknowledgement, assignment, first contact and decision timestamps are populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Tested claim count reconciles to the sampled population drawn from ClaimCenter
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Acknowledgement and decision letters retained with issue dates against the claim
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each timeline breach logged with claim number, control point, required and actual days
generic.Test population: All sampled claims with a regulatory control point reached in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail any control point where actual elapsed days exceed the state required days
generic.Exception handling path: Breaches routed to the handling adjuster supervisor with a response due date
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: State rule matrix defining acknowledgement, contact and decision deadlines by loss state
generic.Evidence location: Timeline monitor output in the BI/reporting platform and claim timestamps in ClaimCenter

steps.title: Test FNOL to acknowledgement elapsed time in the BI/reporting platform
sop: Compute elapsed time from FNOL receipt to acknowledgement for each sampled claim.
Test the result against the loss-state acknowledgement rule.
Done when every sampled claim has an acknowledgement result.
verify: Spot-check one computed interval against the ClaimCenter timestamps.
Pass when acknowledgement timestamps are populated on every sampled claim.

steps.title: Test assignment to first substantive insured contact in ClaimCenter
sop: Compute elapsed time from assignment to first substantive insured contact.
Test the result against the 24-hour standard.
Record contact evidence from the file note or call log.
Done when every sampled claim has a contact result.
verify: Confirm the contact note evidences substantive contact and not an attempt only.
Pass when first-contact timestamps are populated on every sampled claim.

steps.title: Test denial letters for policy provision citation in ClaimCenter
sop: Open each denial or partial denial letter issued in the review window.
Confirm the letter states the specific policy provision relied on.
Confirm it was issued inside the required decision window.
Done when every denial letter is tested.
verify: Read each sampled denial letter for a named policy provision.
Pass when no sampled denial letter omits the policy provision relied on.

steps.title: Test status-update intervals on long-open claims in the BI platform
sop: Identify sampled claims open beyond the state investigation window.
Confirm status-update letters were issued at the required interval.
Done when the status-update test result is recorded per claim.
verify: Compare letter issue dates against the required interval for the loss state.
Pass when every long-open sampled claim shows the required status updates.

steps.title: Record each breach with required and actual days in the BI platform
sop: Record claim number, control point, required days and actual days for each breach.
Group the breaches by loss state and control point.
Done when the breach register for the sample is complete.
verify: Check each breach row shows both required and actual elapsed days.
Pass when no breach is recorded without its required and actual day counts.

steps.title: Route breaches to the handling supervisor from ClaimCenter
sop: Assign each breach to the handling adjuster supervisor.
Set a response due date on each assignment.
Done when every breach is assigned with a response due date.
verify: Re-run the open breach list and check the assignment fields.
Pass when no open breach lacks an assigned supervisor and response due date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Sampled claim files scored section by section on the standardized quality scorecard
generic.In-scope period: Claims scored within the current monthly audit cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every rubric section score, deficiency category, severity and rationale are populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Weighted total equals the sum of the individually scored rubric elements
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scorecard rubric version and scoring date retained with the audit record
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each deficiency recorded with category, severity and a written rationale
generic.Test population: All claims scored on the quality scorecard in the audit cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Weighted total compared against the published pass threshold for the rubric version
generic.Exception handling path: Leakage-bearing deficiencies raised as critical and routed to the debrief regardless of total
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Published severity definitions for critical, major and minor deficiencies
generic.Evidence location: Scorecard on the audit record in Guidewire ClaimCenter and the workbook in Microsoft Excel

steps.title: Score each rubric section individually on the ClaimCenter scorecard
sop: Score coverage, investigation, evaluation, reserving, documentation, timeliness and service in turn.
Avoid carrying one section judgement into another section score.
Done when all seven rubric sections carry a score.
verify: Check no section is left unscored on the scorecard.
Pass when every rubric section shows an individual score.

steps.title: Assign category and severity to each deficiency in ClaimCenter
sop: Assign each deficiency to its category using the published list.
Assign critical, major or minor severity using the published definitions.
Done when every deficiency carries a category and severity.
verify: Check each severity assignment against the published definition.
Pass when no deficiency is left without a category and severity.

steps.title: Mark leakage-bearing deficiencies as critical on the scorecard
sop: Identify overpayment, missed subrogation and missed deductible deficiencies.
Mark each as critical regardless of the section score.
Done when every leakage deficiency is set to critical.
verify: Filter the scorecard for leakage deficiencies and check severity.
Pass when no scorecard records a leakage deficiency at less than critical severity.

steps.title: Recalculate the weighted total in the Microsoft Excel scoring workbook
sop: Load the element scores into the weighted scoring workbook.
Confirm the weighted total recalculates from the element scores.
Compare the total against the pass threshold.
Done when the weighted total and pass result are computed.
verify: Recompute the weighted total independently from the element scores.
Pass when the weighted total equals the sum of the scored elements.

steps.title: Record a written rationale for each deduction in ClaimCenter
sop: Write a one-line rationale for every element scored below full marks.
Cite the file evidence supporting the deduction.
Done when every deduction carries a rationale.
verify: Scan all deducted elements for a rationale entry.
Pass when a rationale exists for each deduction on the scorecard.

steps.title: Finalise and save the scorecard on the audit record
sop: Confirm scores, categories, severities and rationales are complete.
Save the scorecard and record the rubric version used.
Done when the scorecard is saved with its rubric version.
verify: Reopen the saved scorecard and confirm the rubric version is recorded.
Pass when the saved scorecard shows a rubric version and a pass or fail result.

generic.Defined scope/population: Eligible open and closed claims forming the audit sampling population for the period
generic.In-scope period: Claims open or closed within the current monthly sampling period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claim number, line of business, adjuster, severity band and trigger reason are populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sample count reconciles to the eligible population count from the warehouse extract
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Random seed, population count and extract run date retained with the sample list
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims excluded from the eligible population logged with the exclusion reason
generic.Test population: The eligible claim population extracted from the enterprise data warehouse
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Sample must meet the 10% monthly minimum and cover every adjuster each quarter
generic.Exception handling path: Shortfalls in adjuster coverage topped up with additional targeted selections
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Sampling standard defining random seed use and the targeted trigger criteria
generic.Evidence location: Sample extract in the enterprise data warehouse and the published list in Microsoft Excel

steps.title: Pull the eligible claim population from the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Extract open and closed claims for the period with line of business, adjuster and severity band.
Record the population count and the extract run date.
Done when the eligible population extract is produced.
verify: Reconcile the population count against the ClaimCenter claim counts for the period.
Pass when the extract population count matches the source claim counts.

steps.title: Draw the random component using a documented seed in the warehouse
sop: Set and record the random seed before drawing the sample.
Draw the random component from the eligible population.
Store the seed with the sample extract.
Done when the random component is drawn and the seed recorded.
verify: Re-run the draw with the stored seed and compare the selected claims.
Pass when re-running with the stored seed reproduces the same selection.

steps.title: Add targeted-trigger files in the BI/reporting platform
sop: Select large losses over threshold, reopened, litigated and complaint files.
Add files handled by new-hire adjusters.
Tag each selection with its trigger reason.
Done when all targeted-trigger files are added and tagged.
verify: Check every targeted selection carries a trigger reason.
Pass when no sampled claim lacks a random or targeted trigger reason.

steps.title: Test the sample against the 10% minimum in Microsoft Excel
sop: Compute the sample size as a percentage of the eligible population.
Confirm it meets the 10% monthly review minimum.
Top up the sample where it falls short.
Done when the sample meets the minimum.
verify: Recompute the sample percentage from the population and sample counts.
Pass when the sampled file count is at least 10% of the eligible population.

steps.title: Test quarterly adjuster coverage in the BI/reporting platform
sop: List adjusters with no audited file in the current quarter.
Add a selection for each uncovered adjuster.
Done when every adjuster has at least one file in the quarter.
verify: Re-run the adjuster coverage report for the quarter.
Pass when no active adjuster is uncovered in the quarter.

steps.title: Publish the sample list to the audit queue in ClaimCenter
sop: Publish claim numbers, adjuster and trigger reason to the audit queue.
Record the seed, population count and run date with the published list.
Done when the sample list is published to the queue.
verify: Open the published list and confirm seed, population count and reasons are present.
Pass when the sample extract records seed, population count and trigger reason per claim.

generic.Defined scope/population: Open audit corrective actions across all claims teams tracked to evidenced closure
generic.In-scope period: Actions open or closed during the current monthly tracking cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Action owner, due date, current status and remediation evidence link are populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Open plus closed action counts reconcile to actions raised from completed audits
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Remediation evidence attached to each closed action with its completion date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Overdue actions logged with a chase record and a revised commitment date
generic.Test population: All corrective actions raised from audits and not yet evidenced as closed
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Escalate any action more than 10 business days past its due date
generic.Exception handling path: Unsupported closures returned to the action owner with the reason recorded
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Closure standard requiring attached evidence that demonstrates the fix
generic.Evidence location: Corrective actions in the GRC platform with evidence links into Guidewire ClaimCenter

steps.title: Refresh the open corrective-action list in the GRC platform
sop: Run the open corrective-action report for all teams.
Flag every action past its due date.
Done when the refreshed list with overdue flags is produced.
verify: Reconcile the action count against actions raised from completed audits.
Pass when every open action shows an owner, due date and current status.

steps.title: Test the attached evidence for each action in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the evidence attached to each action awaiting closure.
Confirm it demonstrates the actual fix such as a letter issued or reserve corrected.
Done when each action evidence item has been tested.
verify: Open the cited item in ClaimCenter and confirm it matches the action.

generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved transactions returned to the payments team and closure deferred
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Closure financial standard requiring all transactions settled or formally written off
generic.Evidence location: Claim financials in Guidewire ClaimCenter and the payment/subrogation system

steps.title: List all indemnity and expense payments in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the claim financials and list every indemnity and expense payment.
Confirm each shows Issued or Cleared status.
Done when every payment carries a settled status.
verify: Filter the payment list for non-settled statuses.
Pass when every listed payment shows Issued or Cleared.

steps.title: Test for pending or held transactions in the payment system
sop: Query the payment system for the claim number.
Confirm no payment sits in Pending, Held, Rejected or void-and-reissue state.
Escalate any unsettled transaction.
Done when no unsettled transaction remains.
verify: Re-query the payment system after escalation.
Pass when no transaction remains in Pending or Held status on the closing claim.

steps.title: Confirm every recovery is received or written off
sop: List subrogation, salvage, deductible and second-injury fund recoveries.
Confirm each is received or formally written off with a rationale.
Done when every recovery has a settled disposition.
verify: Read the write-off rationale for any unrecovered item.
Pass when no recovery is left open without a receipt or a written-off decision.

steps.title: Reconcile total paid to the payment system for the claim
sop: Sum total paid on the claim record.
Compare against total disbursed in the payment system for the same claim.
Investigate any difference.
Done when the two totals agree or the difference is explained.
verify: Re-run both totals after adjustment.
Pass when total disbursed reconciles to total paid on the claim record.

steps.title: Confirm vendor and expert invoices are settled or accrued
sop: List outstanding vendor and expert assignments on the claim.
Confirm invoices are received and paid or accrued.
Chase any missing invoice before closure.
Done when all invoices are settled or accrued.
verify: Check open purchase or assignment records on the claim.
Pass when no open vendor assignment remains unbilled at closure.

steps.title: Record the financial closure confirmation on the claim
sop: Record the payment and recovery confirmation note on the claim.
State the reconciled paid total in the note.
Done when the confirmation note is saved.
verify: Read the confirmation note against the financial screen.
Pass when the confirmation note states the reconciled paid total.

generic.Defined scope/population: Closed claims feeding the cycle-time, reserve accuracy and payment timeliness metrics
generic.In-scope period: Claims closed within the current closure feed reporting period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loss, report, assignment and closure dates plus initial reserve and final incurred
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Closure feed record count reconciles to claims closed in the period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Feed validation output retained with the run date and rejected record list
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rejected claims logged with the missing field and the correction applied
generic.Test population: All claims closed in the period and submitted to the closure metrics feed
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail any claim entering the feed with a null date or missing reserve value
generic.Exception handling path: Rejected claims returned to the handler for field completion and re-fed
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Closure metric definitions specifying every field required for computation
generic.Evidence location: Closure feed in the enterprise data warehouse validated in the BI/reporting platform

steps.title: Confirm the four cycle-time dates are populated in ClaimCenter
sop: Check loss date, report date, assignment date and closure date on each closed claim.
List claims with any of the four missing.
Done when the missing-date list is produced.
verify: Re-run the date completeness check after correction.
Pass when no closed claim enters the feed with a null loss, report, assignment or closure date.

steps.title: Confirm initial reserve and final incurred are present in ClaimCenter
sop: Check the initial reserve and final incurred values on each closed claim.
List claims missing either value.
Done when the missing-value list is produced.
verify: Re-check the listed claims after correction.
Pass when initial reserve and final incurred are both recorded on the closed claim.

steps.title: Confirm payment issue dates are captured for timeliness
sop: Check payment issue dates are captured against each settlement.
List payments with no issue date recorded.
Done when payment date completeness is confirmed.
verify: Test one settlement for a computable timeliness interval.
Pass when payment timeliness is computable against the settlement date.

steps.title: Confirm segmentation codes are populated in ClaimCenter
sop: Check line of business, cause of loss and closure reason codes on each claim.
List claims with any segmentation code blank.
Done when segmentation completeness is confirmed.
verify: Filter the closed population for blank segmentation codes.
Pass when every closed claim carries line, cause of loss and closure reason codes.

steps.title: Run the closure feed validation in the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Run the closure feed validation for the period.
Extract the rejected record list with the failing field.
Done when the validation output and rejection list are produced.
verify: Reconcile fed record count to claims closed in the period.
Pass when the fed count plus rejections equals claims closed in the period.

steps.title: Correct rejected claims and re-run the feed
sop: Return each rejected claim to the handler with the missing field named.
Confirm the correction and re-run the feed.
Done when the rejection list is clear.
verify: Re-run the validation after correction.
Pass when no claim remains rejected for missing metric fields.

generic.Defined scope/population: Outstanding indemnity, expense and recovery reserves on the claim being closed
generic.In-scope period: Reserve positions as at the intended closure date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Outstanding indemnity, outstanding expense and recovery reserve values are populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of exposure-level outstanding reserves equals zero at claim level
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Closing reserve movement retained with its rationale note and transaction date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reserve releases above handler authority logged with the approval record
generic.Test population: All exposures on the claim carrying an indemnity or expense reserve
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where any non-zero outstanding reserve remains at closure
generic.Exception handling path: Above-authority releases routed for manager approval before posting
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reserving standard requiring a rationale note on every closing reserve movement
generic.Evidence location: Claim financials in Guidewire ClaimCenter and the claims management platform

steps.title: Confirm outstanding indemnity reserve is zero on every exposure
sop: Open the financials and list outstanding indemnity by exposure.
Confirm each exposure shows zero outstanding indemnity.
Done when all exposures show zero indemnity reserve.
verify: Sum outstanding indemnity across exposures.
Pass when total outstanding indemnity reserve is zero at closure.

steps.title: Confirm outstanding expense and ALAE reserve is zero
sop: List outstanding expense and ALAE reserves including defence and expert reserves.
Confirm each is zero.
Done when all expense reserves show zero.
verify: Sum outstanding expense reserve across exposures.
Pass when no non-zero outstanding expense reserve remains at closure.

steps.title: Post the closing reserve movement with a rationale note
sop: Post the closing reserve movement rather than letting the system auto-zero silently.
Write the rationale note explaining the release.
Done when the movement is posted with its note.
verify: Read the transaction and its attached note.
Pass when the closing reserve movement carries a rationale note.

steps.title: Test the release against handler authority in ClaimCenter
sop: Compare the reserve release amount against the handler authority limit.
Route for approval where it exceeds the limit.
Done when the release is within authority or approved.
verify: Check the approval record where the limit is exceeded.
Pass when no above-authority release is posted without an approval record.

steps.title: Verify no recovery reserve remains open on a live pursuit
sop: Check for open recovery reserves on the claim.
Confirm no recovery reserve remains where recovery is still being pursued.
Done when recovery reserve position is confirmed.
verify: Compare open recovery reserves against active recovery records.
Pass when no open recovery reserve sits against an unpursued recovery.

steps.title: Confirm the zero reserve position in the claims management platform
sop: Confirm the zero reserve position replicates to the claims management platform.
Investigate any residual balance shown.
Done when both systems show a zero outstanding position.
verify: Compare outstanding reserve across both systems.
Pass when both systems show zero outstanding indemnity and expense reserve.

generic.Defined scope/population: Closing claims tested against treaty retentions and facultative certificates for the policy year
generic.In-scope period: Claims reaching closure in the current reinsurance review cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty or certificate reference, notification date, ceded share and billing status populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ceded share billed reconciles to paid indemnity and allocated expense on the claim
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reinsurer notification and billing retained with dates on the claim file
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Outstanding receivables logged with an ageing and a chaser date
generic.Test population: All claims closing in the period that pierce a treaty or facultative attachment
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a claim exceeding retention closes with no recovery billing raised
generic.Exception handling path: Late notifications escalated to the reinsurance team before closure is confirmed
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Treaty terms defining retention, notification window and ceded share calculation
generic.Evidence location: Reinsurance administration system records with confirmation on the ClaimCenter claim

steps.title: Test the claim against treaty and facultative attachment
sop: Identify the treaty programme and any facultative certificate for the policy year.
Compare incurred against the retention and attachment point.
Done when the piercing conclusion is recorded.
verify: Recompute incurred against the attachment point.
Pass when every claim above retention is identified as reinsurance eligible.

steps.title: Confirm reinsurer notification within the contractual window
sop: Locate the reinsurer notification on the claim file.
Compare the notification date against the contractual notification window.
Done when notification timing is confirmed or a breach is recorded.
verify: Read the notification evidence in the claim file.
Pass when the notification is evidenced and dated inside the contractual window.

steps.title: Confirm the recovery billing in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Locate the recovery billing for the claim.
Confirm it covers the full ceded share of paid indemnity and allocated expense.
Done when the billing is confirmed complete.
verify: Recompute the ceded share from paid indemnity and allocated expense.
Pass when a recovery billing exists for every claim exceeding treaty retention.

steps.title: Reconcile the ceded share in Microsoft Excel
sop: Extract paid indemnity and allocated expense from ClaimCenter.
Recompute the ceded share against the treaty terms.
Compare against the amount billed.
Done when the reconciliation is complete.
verify: Check the worksheet shows billed and computed shares side by side.
Pass when billed ceded share equals the computed ceded share.

steps.title: Confirm cash received or the receivable is aged
sop: Check whether the recovery cash has been received.
Where outstanding, confirm the receivable is recorded and aged with a chaser date.
Done when the cash or receivable position is confirmed.
verify: Open the receivable record and check the chaser date.
Pass when every outstanding recovery carries an aged receivable and chaser date.

steps.title: Record the reinsurance completion confirmation on the claim
sop: Record the reinsurance confirmation note on the claim before closure.
Reference the billing and receivable position.
Done when the confirmation note is saved before closure.
verify: Read the confirmation note before setting the claim to Closed.
Pass when no claim closes with an unbilled reinsurance recovery.

generic.Defined scope/population: Settled claims requiring executed releases, closing documents and lien satisfactions
generic.In-scope period: Settlements executed on claims closing in the current period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Release parties, release date, release amount, payee and lien status are populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Release amount and payee match the settlement payment actually issued
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Executed release and court orders retained in the repository with execution dates
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing or unsatisfied liens logged and resolved before closure
generic.Test population: All settled exposures on claims presented for closure
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a settled exposure has no fully executed release on file
generic.Exception handling path: Missing closing documents block closure and are chased from the settling party
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Settlement documentation standard covering releases, court approvals and lien clearance
generic.Evidence location: Executed documents in OpenText Document Mgmt indexed to the ClaimCenter claim

steps.title: Confirm the signed release is filed in the claim file repository
sop: Locate the signed release for each settled exposure.
Confirm it is executed by every releasing party and dated.
Done when each settled exposure has an executed release located.
verify: Open the release and check all signature blocks are completed.
Pass when a fully executed release is filed for each settled exposure.

steps.title: Match release amount and payee to the issued payment in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the release amount and named payee.
Compare against the settlement payment actually issued.
Investigate any mismatch before closure.
Done when amount and payee are matched.
verify: Compare the payment record and the release side by side.
Pass when the release amount and payee match the settlement payment issued.

steps.title: Confirm court approval on minor and estate settlements
sop: Identify minor, estate or guardianship settlements on the claim.
Confirm the required court approval order is filed.
Done when court approval is confirmed or the settlement is held.
verify: Open the filed court order and check it matches the settlement terms.
Pass when no minor or estate settlement closes without a filed court approval.

steps.title: Confirm lien satisfactions in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: List medical, Medicare or MSP, statutory and attorney liens on the claim.
Confirm each is documented as satisfied or waived.
Done when every lien has a documented disposition.
verify: Open the satisfaction document for each lien.
Pass when no settled claim closes with an outstanding unsatisfied lien on file.

steps.title: Confirm dismissal or stipulation documents on litigated claims
sop: Identify litigated claims among those closing.
Confirm the dismissal or stipulation document is filed.
Done when litigation closing documents are confirmed filed.
verify: Retrieve the dismissal document from the repository.
Pass when every litigated closing claim has a filed dismissal or stipulation.

steps.title: Record the closing document verification on the claim
sop: Record the verification note listing the documents confirmed.
Flag any missing document as a closure blocker.
Done when the verification note is saved.
verify: Read the verification note against the repository index.
Pass when every document named in the note is present in the repository.

generic.Defined scope/population: Reopened claim elements requiring a fresh coverage determination on the merits
generic.In-scope period: Reopened elements assessed after the reopen date in the current handling period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy version, endorsement list, exclusion analysis and determination date are populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Aggregate erosion applied equals payments already made under the original claim
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: New coverage position document retained with a date after the reopen date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Referrals above handler authority logged with the sign-off decision
generic.Test population: All reopened claims requiring a coverage determination in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where the reopened claim is adjudicated on the original coverage memo alone
generic.Exception handling path: Exposures above handler authority routed to coverage or technical referral
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Coverage determination standard requiring provision citations and supplemental findings
generic.Evidence location: Coverage position document in the claim file repository linked from ClaimCenter

steps.title: Re-read the policy in force at date of loss in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the policy in force at the date of loss including endorsements.
Identify the provisions relevant to the reopened element.
Done when the applicable provisions are identified.
verify: Compare the policy version opened against the date of loss.
Pass when the policy read is the version in force at the date of loss.

steps.title: Assess continuation versus new occurrence in ClaimCenter
sop: Compare the reopened loss facts against the original claim facts.
Conclude whether it is a continuation or a new occurrence.
Record the conclusion and its basis.
Done when the occurrence conclusion is recorded.
verify: Read the conclusion note for the factual basis.
Pass when the occurrence conclusion states the facts relied on.

steps.title: Test the reopened element against exclusions and sublimits
sop: Test the element against exclusions, sublimits and aggregate erosion from prior payment.
Compute remaining limit after the original payment.
Done when the limit and exclusion position is established.
verify: Recompute remaining limit from payments already made.
Pass when aggregate erosion applied equals payments made on the original claim.

steps.title: Document the coverage determination in the claim file repository
sop: Draft the coverage determination citing policy provisions.
Reference the supplemental investigation findings.
File the document against the claim.
Done when the determination is filed with citations.
verify: Open the filed determination and check its date and citations.
Pass when a new coverage position document exists dated after the reopen date.

steps.title: Refer above-authority exposures for technical sign-off
sop: Compare the reopened exposure against the handler authority level.
Refer for coverage or technical sign-off where it exceeds the limit.
Record the sign-off decision on the claim.
Done when the referral outcome is recorded.
verify: Check the sign-off record where authority is exceeded.
Pass when no above-authority determination is issued without a recorded sign-off.

steps.title: Record the coverage position on the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Record the coverage decision on the claim record.
Link the coverage determination document to the decision.
Done when the decision and link are saved on the claim.
verify: Open the linked document from the claim decision.
Pass when no reopened claim is adjudicated on the original coverage memo alone.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims reopened in the period analysed for their underlying reopen drivers
generic.In-scope period: Reopens with a reopen date inside the current analysis period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Original closure date, reopen date, days-closed interval and driver category populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Categorised reopen count equals reopens extracted for the period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Analysis retained with the data cut date and the driver taxonomy version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reopens that resist categorisation logged and reviewed with the handling team
generic.Test population: All claims reopened in the period across every line and team
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Flag reopens within 30 days of closure as premature-closure indicators
generic.Exception handling path: Top drivers handed to the quality and training owners for intervention
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reopen driver taxonomy covering premature closure, missed recovery and deterioration
generic.Evidence location: Reopen analysis in the BI/reporting platform over enterprise data warehouse extracts

steps.title: Extract reopened claims with closure and reopen dates from the warehouse
sop: Extract all claims reopened in the period.
Include original closure date, reopen date and days-closed interval.
Done when the reopen extract is produced.
verify: Reconcile the extract count against reopen transactions in ClaimCenter.
Pass when the extract count equals reopens recorded in the period.

steps.title: Categorise each reopen driver in Microsoft Excel
sop: Assign each reopen to premature closure, missed recovery, late supplemental damage, litigation, deterioration or error.
Use the published taxonomy rather than free text.
Done when every reopen carries a driver category.
verify: Filter the extract for uncategorised reopens.
Pass when each reopened claim carries a categorised reopen driver.

steps.title: Compute reopen rate by line, team and adjuster in the BI platform
sop: Compute reopen rate by line, team and adjuster for the period.
Add the prior period rate for comparison.
Done when all three cuts and the comparative are computed.
verify: Recompute one adjuster rate from the underlying counts.
Pass when reopen rate is reported by line, team and adjuster with prior-period comparison.

steps.title: Isolate reopens within 30 days of closure in the BI platform
sop: Filter reopens where days-closed is 30 or fewer.
Quantify them separately as a premature-closure indicator.
Done when the premature-closure count is produced.
verify: Recompute the interval on a subsample.
Pass when every reopen inside 30 days is counted in the premature-closure measure.

steps.title: Document top drivers with claim exemplars in Microsoft Excel
sop: Rank drivers by volume and by cost impact.
Name exemplar claims for each top driver.
State the data cut date on the analysis.
Done when the top drivers are documented with exemplars.
verify: Check each top driver names at least one exemplar claim.
Pass when no top driver is documented without a claim exemplar.

steps.title: Hand the driver analysis to quality and training owners
sop: Review the driver analysis and premature-closure measure.
Direct the top drivers to the quality and training owners.
Record the handover and the owners named.
Done when the handover is recorded with named owners.
verify: Check the handover record for named owners.
Pass when every top driver is assigned to a named quality or training owner.

generic.Defined scope/population: Reopened claims requiring assignment to a handler with the right skill and authority
generic.In-scope period: Claims reopened during the current assignment cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Reopened exposure value, required authority level, owner and supervisor are populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assigned reopened claim count equals reopens created in the period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assignment date and assigning user retained on the claim record
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reopens routed away from the original handler logged with the routing reason
generic.Test population: All claims reopened and awaiting handler assignment
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a large-loss reopen is assigned below the required authority level
generic.Exception handling path: Above-threshold exposures escalated to a senior or complex-loss handler
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assignment standard mapping exposure value and complexity to handler authority
generic.Evidence location: Assignment record on the claim in Guidewire ClaimCenter and the claims management platform

steps.title: Assess reopened exposure value and complexity in ClaimCenter
sop: Evaluate the reopened exposure value and its complexity.
Determine the required handler skill and authority level.
Done when the required authority level is recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded level against the assignment standard.
Pass when the required authority level matches the exposure value band.

steps.title: Route to the original handler where appropriate
sop: Check whether the original handler remains available.
Route back to them where the reopen is not error-driven.
Record the routing decision.
Done when the routing decision is recorded.
verify: Read the routing reason on the claim.
Pass when no error-driven reopen is routed back to the original handler.

steps.title: Escalate large-loss reopens to a senior handler in ClaimCenter
sop: Compare the reopened exposure against the large-loss threshold.
Route above-threshold claims to a senior or complex-loss handler.
Done when above-threshold claims are routed appropriately.
verify: Compare handler authority against the exposure for each routed claim.
Pass when no reopened claim above the large-loss threshold sits below the required authority.

steps.title: Set the claim owner and supervisor in ClaimCenter
sop: Set the claim owner to the assigned handler.
Set the supervising manager on the claim.
Confirm the assignment date is recorded.
Done when owner, supervisor and date are set.
verify: Reopen the claim and check the assignment fields.
Pass when the reopened claim shows a current owner with an assignment date after the reopen date.

steps.title: Notify the assigned handler with reopen reason and file summary
sop: Send the reopen reason and the original file summary to the assigned handler.
Record the notification on the claim.
Done when the handler notification is recorded.
verify: Check the notification record on the claim.
Pass when every assigned reopen shows a recorded handler notification.

steps.title: Confirm the assignment replicates in the claims management platform
sop: Confirm the owner and supervisor replicate to the claims management platform.
Investigate any assignment failing to update.
Done when both systems show the same assignment.
verify: Compare the owner field across both systems.
Pass when both systems show the same current owner for the reopened claim.

generic.Defined scope/population: Reopened claims where a coverage position must be communicated to the insured
generic.In-scope period: Coverage decisions falling due within the loss-state regulatory window
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loss state deadline, letter send date, provisions cited and appeal rights flag populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Letters issued count equals reopened coverage decisions made in the period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued letter and send date retained against the claim in the repository
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Late communications logged with the reason and the compliance disposition
generic.Test population: All reopened claims with a coverage decision communicated in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where the letter send date falls outside the loss-state regulatory window
generic.Exception handling path: Approaching deadlines escalated through the diary to the supervising examiner
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Letter standard requiring plain language, provision citation and appeal rights
generic.Evidence location: Issued letter in the claim file repository with the diary record in ClaimCenter

steps.title: Diary the loss-state coverage decision deadline in ClaimCenter
sop: Identify the loss-state deadline for the reopened coverage decision.
Create a diary entry ahead of the deadline.
Done when the deadline is diarised on the claim.
verify: Compare the diary date against the state deadline.
Pass when the diary date falls before the regulatory deadline.

steps.title: Draft the coverage position letter in plain language
sop: State the decision in plain language.
Cite the policy provisions relied on.
Done when the draft states the decision and provisions.
verify: Read the draft for the provision citation.
Pass when the draft cites the specific policy provisions relied on.

steps.title: Include appeal, review or complaint rights where required
sop: Check whether the state or policy requires appeal or complaint rights on a denial.
Add the required wording to the letter.
Done when required rights wording is included or confirmed not required.
verify: Compare the letter against the state requirement.
Pass when no reopened denial letter omits required appeal or complaint rights.

steps.title: Issue the letter to the insured and attorney within the deadline
sop: Issue the letter to the insured and, where applicable, the claimant attorney.
Capture the send date.
Done when the letter is issued and the send date captured.
verify: Compare the send date against the diarised deadline.
Pass when the letter is issued on or before the regulatory deadline.

steps.title: File the issued letter against the claim in the repository
sop: File the issued letter and its send date against the claim.
Index it to the claim number in the repository.
Done when the letter is filed and indexed.
verify: Retrieve the letter by claim number.
Pass when the coverage position letter is filed with a send date inside the window.

steps.title: Close the diary entry and record compliance in ClaimCenter
sop: Close the coverage decision diary entry.
Record the compliance outcome against the deadline.
Done when the diary is closed with an outcome recorded.
verify: Re-run the open diary report for the claim.
Pass when no coverage decision diary remains open after the letter is issued.

generic.Defined scope/population: Reopened claims requiring supplemental investigation of the new loss element
generic.In-scope period: Evidence gathered after the reopen date in the current investigation window
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Investigation question, evidence type, evidence date and reconciliation note populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: New evidence item count matches the items requested in the investigation plan
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: New estimates, records and photographs indexed to the claim with their dates
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Evidence requested but not obtained logged with the reason and next step
generic.Test population: All reopened claims with a supplemental investigation opened in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where the reopen decision rests on evidence dated before the reopen date
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed supplemental damage routed to an expert or re-inspection assignment
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Investigation standard requiring a stated question and a reconciliation to original findings
generic.Evidence location: Evidence indexed in the claim file repository with notes in Guidewire ClaimCenter

steps.title: Define the supplemental investigation question in ClaimCenter
sop: State the specific question the supplemental investigation must answer.
Record it as an investigation plan note on the claim.
Done when the question is documented on the claim.
verify: Read the plan note for a single specific question.
Pass when the investigation plan states a specific question rather than a general review.

steps.title: Obtain the new supporting evidence into the claim file repository
sop: Request the supplemental estimate, new medical records or new damage photographs.
Index each item to the claim with its date.
Done when the requested evidence is obtained and indexed.
verify: Check each evidence item date against the reopen date.
Pass when new evidence obtained after the reopen date is indexed to the claim.

steps.title: Take a supplemental recorded statement where the account changed
sop: Compare the current factual account against the original statement.
Take a supplemental recorded statement where the account has changed.
Index the statement to the claim.
Done when the statement is taken or the need is ruled out.
verify: Read the note explaining why a statement was or was not taken.
Pass when every changed factual account has a supplemental statement or a documented reason.

steps.title: Engage an expert or re-inspection on disputed damage
sop: Identify where the supplemental damage claim is disputed.
Assign an expert or re-inspection and record the assignment.
Done when the assignment is recorded or ruled out.
verify: Check the assignment record against the disputed element.
Pass when every disputed supplemental damage item has an expert or inspection assignment.

steps.title: Reconcile new evidence against the original findings in ClaimCenter
sop: Compare the new evidence against the original investigation findings.
Document the reconciliation including any contradiction.
Done when the reconciliation note is saved.
verify: Read the reconciliation note for both sets of findings.
Pass when a note reconciles the supplemental findings against the original investigation.

steps.title: Document the supplemental findings conclusion on the claim
sop: Summarise the supplemental findings and answer the stated question.
Record the conclusion on the claim record.
Done when the findings conclusion is recorded.
verify: Compare the conclusion against the stated investigation question.
Pass when the conclusion directly answers the documented investigation question.

generic.Defined scope/population: Reopen requests tested against the statute of limitations and contractual filing periods
generic.In-scope period: Requests assessed before any substantive reopen handling begins
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Date of loss, closure or denial date, tolling events and computed expiry are populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Computed expiry date reconciles to the loss date plus the state limitation period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Limitation note retained on the claim with the dates and authorities relied on
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Time-barred conclusions logged with the legal referral outcome
generic.Test population: All reopen requests received in the period requiring a timing assessment
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a time-barred claim is reopened with no documented legal referral
generic.Exception handling path: Arguable positions referred to counsel before the reopen decision is made
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Limitation standard covering state statutes, suit-limitation clauses and tolling
generic.Evidence location: Limitation note on the claim in ClaimCenter with documents in the claim file repository

steps.title: Identify the key dates on the file in ClaimCenter
sop: Record the date of loss and the date of original denial or closure.
Identify any tolling event recorded on the file.
Done when all key dates are recorded.
verify: Cross-check the dates against the claim transaction history.
Pass when the recorded dates match the claim history.

steps.title: Apply the loss-state statute of limitations
sop: Identify the state statute of limitations for the cause of action.
Compute the expiry date from the applicable trigger date.
Record the computed expiry date on the claim.
Done when the expiry date is computed and recorded.
verify: Recompute the expiry from the trigger date and statute period.
Pass when the recorded expiry matches the recomputed date.

steps.title: Check the policy suit-limitation and proof-of-loss clauses
sop: Open the policy in the claim file repository.
Check the contractual suit-limitation and proof-of-loss clauses.
Determine whether either shortens the period.
Done when the contractual position is established.
verify: Compare the contractual period against the statutory period.
