steps.title: Build negotiation scenarios from real settled claims in Excel
sop: Select real settled claims as the basis for each scenario.
Set the evaluation range and authority limit in the brief.
Done when each scenario has an evaluation range and authority limit.
verify: Read each brief for a stated authority limit.
Pass when no simulation is run without a defined authority limit in the brief.

steps.title: Assign roles and brief each side separately
sop: Assign adjuster, claimant attorney and observer roles.
Brief each side separately on their position.
Done when roles are assigned and briefs issued.
verify: Check each participant received only their side brief.
Pass when no participant holds the opposing side brief before the simulation.

steps.title: Run the simulation and score against the observer sheet
sop: Observe the negotiation against the observer sheet.
Score preparation, use of authority and documentation of the offer.
Done when each participant is scored on all three dimensions.
verify: Check every participant has a completed observer sheet.
Pass when each participant has an observer score on all three dimensions.

steps.title: Debrief the simulation against the actual settlement outcome
sop: Compare the simulated outcome against the actual settlement on the source claim.
Debrief the participants on the difference.
Done when every simulation is debriefed against the source outcome.
verify: Check the debrief note cites the actual settlement outcome.
Pass when every debrief cites the actual settlement on the source claim.

steps.title: Record development points in the learning record
sop: Agree the individual development point from the observer feedback.
Record it in the personal learning record.
Done when the development point is recorded.
verify: Open the learning record for the participant.
Pass when each participant has a recorded development point.

steps.title: Record participation in the learning management system
sop: Record participation for each attendee against the simulation.
Chase absentees onto the next session.
Done when participation is recorded for the cohort.
verify: Compare participation records against the cohort list.
Pass when every cohort member has a participation or catch-up record.

generic.Defined scope/population: Training needs derived from audit deficiencies, compliance findings and performance data
generic.In-scope period: Evidence drawn from the current quality, compliance and performance reporting period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Need, source evidence, affected cohort and affected population size are populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Affected population sizes reconcile to the claims headcount by cohort
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Needs list retained with the source evidence references and the data cut date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Needs without supporting evidence removed with the reason recorded
generic.Test population: All audit deficiencies, compliance exceptions and outlier findings for the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Rank needs by deficiency frequency and severity before prioritisation
generic.Exception handling path: Regulatory-driven needs prioritised ahead of the general curriculum backlog
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Needs analysis standard requiring evidence and population size for every need
generic.Evidence location: Needs list in Microsoft Excel built from BI reports and ClaimCenter audit records

steps.title: Aggregate period audit deficiencies by category in the BI platform
sop: Aggregate the period audit deficiencies by category.
Rank by frequency and by severity.
Done when the ranked deficiency list is produced.
verify: Reconcile the deficiency counts against the audit records in ClaimCenter.
Pass when the aggregated counts equal the audit record counts.

steps.title: Overlay compliance exceptions and complaint root causes
sop: Overlay compliance exceptions for the period.
Overlay DOI complaint root causes.
Done when regulatory-driven needs are identified.
verify: Check each regulatory need traces to an exception or complaint.
Pass when every regulatory need cites an exception or complaint source.

steps.title: Overlay performance outliers and reopen drivers
sop: Overlay the performance outlier list for the period.
Overlay the categorised reopen drivers.
Done when technical and closure discipline gaps are identified.
verify: Check each gap traces to an outlier or reopen driver.
Pass when every technical need cites an outlier or reopen driver source.

steps.title: Segment each need by cohort in Microsoft Excel
sop: Segment each need by line, team, tenure band and new-hire population.
Record the affected population size per segment.
Done when every need is segmented and sized.
verify: Reconcile the population sizes against claims headcount.
Pass when each need carries an affected population size.

steps.title: Remove needs without supporting evidence
sop: Review each proposed need for supporting evidence.
Remove any need with no audit, compliance or performance source.
Record the removal reason.
Done when unsupported needs are removed.
verify: Scan the final list for needs without an evidence citation.
Pass when no training need is listed without supporting evidence.

steps.title: Publish the prioritised training needs list
sop: Prioritise the needs by frequency, severity and regulatory driver.
Publish the list with evidence references and population sizes.
Done when the prioritised needs list is published.
verify: Open the published list and check the evidence column.
Pass when each identified need cites its source evidence and affected population size.

generic.Defined scope/population: Files handled by the trained cohort after the training date, re-audited for improvement
generic.In-scope period: Files opened or handled after the training delivery date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Baseline rate, rubric version, post-training sample size and post rate are populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Post-training sample count reconciles to eligible post-training files for the cohort
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Baseline and post-training audit records retained with the rubric version used
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cohorts with no improvement logged with the reason and the planned response
generic.Test population: Files handled by the trained cohort after the training date
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Improvement measured as the change in the target deficiency rate against baseline
generic.Exception handling path: No improvement routed back for module redesign or individual coaching
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Re-audit standard requiring identical rubric versions for baseline and post-training
generic.Evidence location: Baseline and post-training audits in ClaimCenter with rates in the BI platform

steps.title: Fix the pre-training baseline deficiency rate in the BI platform
sop: Extract the pre-training deficiency rate for the target category and cohort.
Record the baseline rate and its rubric version.
Done when the baseline is fixed and recorded.
verify: Recompute the baseline from the pre-training audit records.
Pass when the recorded baseline reproduces from the pre-training audits.

steps.title: Draw the post-training sample from post-date files
sop: Filter cohort files handled after the training date.
Draw the post-training audit sample from those files only.
Done when the post-training sample is drawn.
verify: Check the file open dates in the sample against the training date.
Pass when post-training audits are drawn only from files opened after the training date.

steps.title: Score the sample on the identical rubric version
sop: Load the same rubric version used for the baseline audit.
Score the post-training sample on that rubric.
Done when the sample is scored on the baseline rubric version.
verify: Compare the rubric versions on baseline and post-training audits.
Pass when baseline and post-training rates are reported on the same rubric version.

steps.title: Compute the change in the target deficiency rate
sop: Compute the post-training deficiency rate for the target category.
Compute the change against the baseline.
State the sample size behind the result.
Done when the change and sample size are computed.
verify: Recompute the change from the two rates.
Pass when the reported change reproduces from the baseline and post rates.

steps.title: Record the reason where the rate has not improved
sop: Where the rate has not improved, investigate the cause.
Record the reason on the module effectiveness record.
Done when every non-improving result carries a reason.
verify: Read the reason recorded against each non-improving result.
Pass when no non-improving result is left without a recorded reason.

steps.title: Route non-improving modules for redesign or coaching
sop: Route the module back for redesign where the cohort did not improve.
Route individuals for coaching where the failure is individual.
Done when each non-improving result has a routed action.
verify: Check each non-improving result for a routed action.
Pass when every non-improving result has a redesign or coaching action.

generic.Defined scope/population: Training effectiveness and curriculum updates reported to the Chief Claims Officer
generic.In-scope period: Modules delivered and measured within the current reporting period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Completion rate, pre rate, post rate, planned response and delivery date are populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Completion rates reconcile to learning system records for each cohort
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report retained with the delivery date and the underlying measurement cut date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Modules with no improvement reported with the planned response
generic.Test population: All targeted modules delivered and re-audited in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Effectiveness judged on measured deficiency change, not attendance figures
generic.Exception handling path: Ineffective modules carried forward with a redesign commitment and owner
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reporting standard requiring paired completion and deficiency measurement
generic.Evidence location: Effectiveness report in the BI/reporting platform over learning system data

steps.title: Report completion rates by cohort from the learning system
sop: Extract completion rates by cohort for each module delivered.
Pair each rate with the measured quality improvement.
Done when completion and improvement are paired per module.
verify: Reconcile completion rates against the learning system records.
Pass when reported completion rates equal the learning system figures.

steps.title: Show pre and post deficiency rates per targeted module
sop: Show the deficiency rate before and after training for each targeted module.
State the rubric version and sample size behind each.
Done when both rates are shown for every targeted module.
verify: Compare the rates against the re-audit results.
Pass when the report pairs completion rates with measured pre and post deficiency rates.

steps.title: Call out modules with no measured improvement
sop: Identify modules where the deficiency rate did not improve.
State the planned response for each.
Done when every non-improving module carries a planned response.
verify: Check each called-out module has a stated response.
Pass when no module is reported as effective on attendance figures alone.

steps.title: Set out planned curriculum changes and their evidence
sop: List the curriculum changes planned for the next period.
State the evidence driving each change.
Done when every planned change cites its evidence.
verify: Check each planned change against the needs analysis.
Pass when every planned curriculum change cites its driving evidence.

steps.title: Review the effectiveness report with the Chief Claims Officer
sop: Review the paired completion and deficiency measures.
Challenge any module reported effective without measurement.
Approve the report and the curriculum plan.
Done when the review and approval are recorded.
verify: Check the approval record before delivery is closed.
Pass when no report is closed without a recorded leadership review.

steps.title: Deliver the report and record the delivery date
sop: Deliver the approved report to the Chief Claims Officer.
Record the delivery date on the report record.
Done when the report is delivered and dated.
verify: Open the report record and check the delivery date.
Pass when the delivery date is recorded for the effectiveness report.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every active adjuster tracked for mandatory training completion and competency assessment
generic.In-scope period: The current monthly tracking cycle with mandatory module due dates
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Completion status, completion date, competency result and assessment date populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Learning system roster reconciles to current claims headcount with no gaps
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Completion and competency records retained with their dates in the learning system
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Overdue mandatory modules logged and notified to the line manager
generic.Test population: All active adjusters on the claims headcount for the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Overdue where a mandatory module passes its due date without completion
generic.Exception handling path: Overdue individuals escalated to their line manager for completion
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Training tracking standard listing mandatory modules and assessment frequency
generic.Evidence location: Learning management system records reported through the BI/reporting platform

steps.title: Reconcile the learning roster to claims headcount
sop: Load the current claims headcount.
Compare it against the learning system roster.
Add missing joiners to the roster.
Done when the roster matches headcount.
verify: Re-run the roster comparison after additions.
Pass when no active adjuster is missing from the training tracking roster.

steps.title: Record completion status per mandatory module
sop: Record completion status and date for each mandatory module per adjuster.
Correct any status not reflecting the learning system record.
Done when every adjuster has a status per mandatory module.
verify: Filter for adjusters with blank completion status.
Pass when every active adjuster has a completion status per mandatory module.

steps.title: Record competency assessment results and dates
sop: Record the competency assessment result per adjuster.
Record the date of the last assessment.
Done when every adjuster has a result and assessment date.
verify: Filter for adjusters with blank assessment dates.
Pass when every active adjuster has a competency assessment date.

steps.title: Flag overdue mandatory modules in the learning system
sop: Compare completion dates against module due dates.
Flag every adjuster with an overdue mandatory module.
Done when all overdue adjusters are flagged.
verify: Recompute overdue status from due dates and completion dates.
Pass when every adjuster past a mandatory due date is flagged overdue.

steps.title: Notify line managers of overdue individuals
sop: Notify the line manager of each overdue adjuster.
Record the notification date against the adjuster.
Done when every overdue adjuster has a manager notification.
verify: Check the notification record for each overdue adjuster.
Pass when no overdue adjuster is left without a manager notification.

steps.title: Report completion percentage by team in the BI platform
sop: Compute completion percentage by team.
Count overdue individuals per team.
Add both to the monthly pack.
Done when the team figures are published in the pack.
verify: Reconcile the pack figures against the learning system roster.
Pass when the pack figures equal the learning system completion records.
